label: Email Access
description: Connects a mailbox by address and password over IMAP (receive) and SMTP (send), for any provider; fill the server half you need, or both. Gmail and Outlook need an app password (Gmail: imap.gmail.com / smtp.gmail.com).

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.placeholder: For Gmail/Outlook: an app password, not the account password

fields.name: imapHost
fields.label: Incoming server (IMAP)
fields.placeholder: imap.gmail.com (leave empty if you only send)

fields.name: smtpHost
fields.label: Outgoing server (SMTP)
fields.placeholder: smtp.gmail.com (leave empty if you only receive)

fields.name: sendAs
fields.label: Send as
fields.placeholder: Only if you send from an alias: Your Name <alias@example.com>

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the email trigger and SendEmail.
